name: Hard Press
effect: Remove 1 Dice from the Damage Roll for every 20% of missing HP the target has, rounded up. You can use `/calculate_hp_damage_modifier` to calculate this for you. Ignores Screens. Reduce the duration of Screens on the target's side of the battlefield by 2 Rounds. On a Critical Strike, reduce the duration by 3 Rounds instead. If the target is behind any active Screens when performed, add 2 Extra Dice to the Damage Pool.
description: The user aims to crush their foe, using their own weight against them.
